scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && concurrently -k -n web,api,worker "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:worker"
scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace @guardian-wallet/shared && npm run build --workspace @guardian-wallet/planner && npm run build --workspace @guardian-wallet/wallet && npm run build --workspace @guardian-wallet/database
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace @guardian-wallet/api && npm run build --workspace @guardian-wallet/worker && npm run build --workspace @guardian-wallet/web && npm run compile --workspace @guardian-wallet/contracts
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
